name: Heel Fall
description: Your best option after this is 2B > 5B > command combo. Vertical Arrow is prone to whiffing at most ranges, and light slicer doesn't grant a hard knockdown.

name: Command Combo 1
damage: Far B > D: 40 / Far B~D > D: 50
description: The 2nd kick is largely similar to her far D but with a worse hitbox that will not hit crouching opponents even if close. It is +3 on block for some reason. However, if the initial far B hits, the 2nd kick will hit crouching opponents. It can also be slightly delayed, allowing extra time for hit-confirms or the ability to mess up an opponent's JD/HD timing. name: Command Combo 2
description: Only comes out if far D hit or was blocked. While it helps to have your pokes do more damage, this Command Combo has a lot of problems. It’s always unsafe on block, you’re never in throw range on hit, and doing it means you lose out on far D’s excellent Counter Hit or Wild Punish conversions. It’s good for when far D Counter Hits an airborne or backdashing opponent, but that’s about it.

name: Command Combo 3
description: Can only be done during a full jump. Hitting it on an airborne opponent while descending allows you to or Quick Step under the opponent to go to the other side. Slightly delaying the dash fakes this cross-under and keeps you same side.

name: M. Spinning Kick
description: It really struggles to hit anyone in the air, the hitbox is not good. Travels super far forward before coming out, making it easy to whiff punish and easier to grab. Hits OTG, and is in fact Mary’s most damaging OTG by a mile when it’s available. Use it when your sweep Wild Punishes.

name: M. Spider: R
description: Does not go into the hitgrab if it hits an airborne opponent, but the full damage of the REV Blow will instead be on the first hit. Also does not go into the hitgrab on counter hit, but does not deal full damage on grounded opponents.

name: Vertical Arrow BR
description: Only the D version allows a manual follow-up, while BD triggers it automatically if not braked. Not invincible on startup except to air attacks. One of the slower brakeable DPs in the game at 9 frames but launches the opponent unusually high. Usually followed with a charged (i.e. non-dash) D Straight Slicer, which can be juggled into any of her non-command grab supers, or a 623B. Mary can even combo into a ground REV blow off of this due to the juggle height. name: M. Dynamite Swing
description: Both versions have generous invincibility on startup. Switches sides on hit. Becomes an unblockable air grab if it doesn’t hit on the early active frames. Taking into account her other command grab super - if used as a reversal, this forces her opponent into a quick reaction check to either block or jump in order to not get hit.
